title: Chattooga River near Clayton — 2012-reference retrospective native comparison

scope.selection: Exact original regional calibration COMID joined to published reach HUC8
scope.spatial_dependence: Retain actual upstream-basin overlap groups; no station/constituent split may cross a leakage group
scope.geographic_relationship: Upper Chattooga tributary contributing to the Tugaloo arm of Hartwell
scope.retrospective_basis: Original source target horizon and reference year retained; land cover and climate are separately selected retrospective inputs.

records.comparability_note: Long-term annual target referenced to 2012 with source-global WY2000–2014 support. The historical native baseline uses legacy NLCD2011 (2011 edition, amended 2014) and the original PRISM period mean. Annual NLCD2011 and Annual NLCD2012 are separate controlled alternatives. Original nutrient station IDs combine observations; sediment is TSS (00530). Full upstream support, unavailable target estimator uncertainty, point-source and in-stream transport, and product editions remain explicit in interpretation.
